Firm Identifiers.FirmID: Unique identifier for each firm (FIRM_001 to FIRM_300)
Firm Identifiers.Size: Firm size category (SME: <250 employees, Large: ≥250 employees)
Firm Identifiers.Subsector: Food processing subsector (e.g., Dairy, Beverages, Bakery)
Firm Identifiers.OwnershipType: Ownership structure (Private Nigerian, Foreign, Joint Venture, etc.)

FDI Variables.FDI_Type: Type of FDI (Greenfield, M&A, Joint Venture)
FDI Variables.FDI_Years: Number of years since FDI entry

FDI Constructs (Likert 1-5).Knowledge_Absorption: Firm's ability to acquire and assimilate external knowledge
FDI Constructs (Likert 1-5).Task_Performance: Efficiency and quality of task execution
FDI Constructs (Likert 1-5).Innovation_Score: Level of product and process innovation

Performance Metrics.Market_Share: Firm's market share in Lagos food processing sector (%)
Performance Metrics.Export_Intensity: Exports as percentage of total sales (%)

Financial Indicators.Revenue_Million_NGN: Annual revenue in millions of Naira
Financial Indicators.Assets_Million_NGN: Total assets in millions of Naira
Financial Indicators.Export_Value_Million_NGN: Export value in millions of Naira

Technology & Innovation.RD_Spend_Percentage: R&D spending as percentage of revenue (%)

Macro-Economic Context.FDI_Inflow_Lagos_Million_USD: Total FDI inflow to Lagos (Million USD)
